secSandboxLayers.title: Manifest declaration
secSandboxLayers.description: Plugins declare required capabilities upfront. Runtime refuses undeclared access.

secSandboxLayers.title: In-process isolation
secSandboxLayers.description: Default mode. Plugin runs in the same process with permission enforcement via middleware.

secSandboxLayers.title: Subprocess isolation
secSandboxLayers.description: Plugin spawns in a child process. IPC-only communication, no shared memory.

secSandboxLayers.title: Container isolation
secSandboxLayers.description: Plugin runs in an OCI container. Full filesystem and network isolation.

page.secSandboxSubtitle: A plugin cannot access resources it didn't declare in its manifest — that's a contract, not a recommendation.
page.secHeroDescription: KB Labs runs on-prem by default, open source end-to-end, and never sends data without your explicit action. Everything below is verifiable in source.
page.secMetaDesc: On-prem by default, open source, plugin sandboxing, JWT Gateway auth. No data leaves without your consent.

secPillars.title: On-prem by default
secPillars.description: KB Labs runs entirely on your infrastructure. No cloud dependency, no data leaving your network. You control where your code, workflow state, and logs are stored.

secPillars.title: Consent-first data sharing
secPillars.description: Nothing is sent externally without explicit user consent. The CLI installer asks before every network call. Demo mode offers three choices: gateway proxy, local only, or bring your own API key.

secPillars.title: Open source & auditable
secPillars.description: The entire platform is open source. Every line of code is auditable. No black boxes, no hidden telemetry, no trust-us-it's-safe. Verify yourself.
